entries.title: Numbers 19:1
segments: ¶Now the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 19:2
segments: "This [is] the ordinance of the law which the LORD has commanded, saying: 'Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring you a red heifer without blemish, in which there [ is] no defect [and] on which a yoke has never come.

entries.title: Numbers 19:3
segments: 'You shall give it to Eleazar the priest, that he may take it outside the camp, and it shall be slaughtered before him;

entries.title: Numbers 19:4
segments: 'and Eleazar the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and sprinkle some of its blood seven times directly in front of the tabernacle of meeting.

entries.title: Numbers 19:5
segments: 'Then the heifer shall be burned in his sight: its hide, its flesh, its blood, and its offal shall be burned.

entries.title: Numbers 19:6
segments: 'And the priest shall take cedar wood and hyssop and scarlet, and cast [them] into the midst of the fire burning the heifer.

entries.title: Numbers 19:7
segments: 'Then the priest shall wash his clothes, he shall bathe in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp; the priest shall be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Numbers 19:8
segments: 'And the one who burns it shall wash his clothes in water, bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Numbers 19:9
segments: 'Then a man [who is] clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and store [them] outside the camp in a clean place; and they shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for the water of purification; it [is] for purifying from sin.

entries.title: Numbers 19:10
segments: 'And the one who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until evening. It shall be a statute forever to the children of Israel and to the stranger who dwells among them.

entries.title: Numbers 19:11
segments: ¶'He who touches the dead body of anyone shall be unclean seven days.

entries.title: Numbers 19:12
segments: 'He shall purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; [then] he will be clean. But if he does not purify himself on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not be clean.

entries.title: Numbers 19:13
segments: 'Whoever touches the body of anyone who has died, and does not purify himself, defiles the tabernacle of the LORD. That person shall be cut off from Israel. He shall be unclean, because the water of purification was not sprinkled on him; his uncleanness [is] still on him.

entries.title: Numbers 19:14
segments: 'This [is] the law when a man dies in a tent: All who come into the tent and all who [are] in the tent shall be unclean seven days;

entries.title: Numbers 19:15
segments: 'and every open vessel, which has no cover fastened on it, [is] unclean.

entries.title: Numbers 19:16
segments: 'Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain by a sword or who has died, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

entries.title: Numbers 19:17
segments: 'And for an unclean [person] they shall take some of the ashes of the heifer burnt for purification from sin, and running water shall be put on them in a vessel.

entries.title: Numbers 19:18
segments: 'A clean person shall take hyssop and dip [it] in the water, sprinkle [it] on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, or on the one who touched a bone, the slain, the dead, or a grave.

entries.title: Numbers 19:19
segments: 'The clean [person] shall sprinkle the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day; and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, wash his clothes, and bathe in water; and at evening he shall be clean.

entries.title: Numbers 19:20
segments: 'But the man who is unclean and does not purify himself, that person shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water of purification has not been sprinkled on him; he [is] unclean.

entries.title: Numbers 19:21
segments: 'It shall be a perpetual statute for them. He who sprinkles the water of purification shall wash his clothes; and he who touches the water of purification shall be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Numbers 19:22
segments: 'Whatever the unclean [person] touches shall be unclean; and the person who touches [it] shall be unclean until evening.'"
